rule: A historical R8 contract is NEVER edited or deleted. A superseded contract keeps its test, inputs and expectation byte-for-byte (legacy_hash) and runs as a strict xfail of class CONTRACT_SUPERSEDED; the superseding expectation is asserted against production by a new test. A hash mismatch fails the suite.

entries.legacy_rationale: R8.0 predicted PROVISIONAL when only GEOMETRY_PLAUSIBILITY contradicts INSUNITS
entries.problem: PROVISIONAL is the status one step below CONFIRMED_BY_HUMAN. Granting it on plausibility alone would let plausibility + one human claim reach FINAL, contradicting the spec's own rule that plausibility is support-only. The spec's table puts 'declaration only' at UNCONFIRMED; plausibility adds a question, not strength.
entries.new_decision: A declaration contested only by plausibility stays UNCONFIRMED and raises UNIT_PLAUSIBILITY_QUESTION.
entries.superseding_authority: R8.4 brief §8-§10 (Mohammad / Urban review of R8.3), implemented by Claude; semantic basis: R8 revised spec §5 status table (v1 sha 9bb2433d1817…, later edition sha 17e1a9cddcad…): plausibility is support-only and 'declaration only' is UNCONFIRMED
entries.migration_effect: None on published quantities. Both PROVISIONAL and UNCONFIRMED forbid FINAL and allow PREVIEW; the difference only matters once a human claim is added, where UNCONFIRMED keeps plausibility from becoming half of a FINAL basis.

entries.legacy_rationale: R8.0 mutation: two plausibility items must not count toward VERIFIED; predicted PROVISIONAL
entries.problem: The mutation's intent (plausibility never counts toward VERIFIED) is kept and holds; only its status prediction PROVISIONAL is wrong for the same reason as F17: repetition of plausibility cannot add strength.
entries.new_decision: Same as F17; the 'not counted toward VERIFIED' half of the legacy expectation is retained unchanged.
entries.superseding_authority: R8.4 brief §8-§10 (Mohammad / Urban review of R8.3), implemented by Claude; semantic basis: R8 revised spec §5 status table (v1 sha 9bb2433d1817…, later edition sha 17e1a9cddcad…): plausibility is support-only and 'declaration only' is UNCONFIRMED

entries.legacy_rationale: R8_DECISION_LOG D-08 (sha 3511c8bd3c41…): Al Rashed PROVISIONAL because 'two independent kinds agree and they contradict a declaration' — the kinds being the printed plot size, the dimension display ratio and wall-pair spacing; spec §5 PROVISIONAL row '≥2 agreeing kinds that contradict a declaration (Al Rashed)'
entries.problem: The expectation DEPENDS on admitting evidence R8.3 found inadmissible as physical support: the dimension display ratio is a DIMLFAC / display family whose display unit is not authored (candidate, a set of interpretations; set membership is never support), plot size and wall-pair spacing are plausibility (support-only). With them excluded the admitted physical independent set is 0, not 1, and the status cannot be PROVISIONAL-from-evidence.
entries.new_decision: Supersede. Candidate and plausibility evidence are never counted in the admitted independent set and never raise a status; a declaration contradicted by candidate families is a CONFLICT/QUESTION for a human, never PROVISIONAL. The real-source half stays gated on URBAN_R8_REAL_SOURCE and asserts behaviour, not a count.

new_expectation.real_source_behaviour: UNIT_CONTEXT not stronger than UNCONFIRMED without admitted physical evidence

entries.problem: R8.3 left F19 TARGET_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and stated that no R8 document defines V-CAD-n. That statement was WRONG: R8.3 searched only the scratchpad spec v1 (sha 9bb2433d1817…). The later spec edition data/reports/URBAN_QTO_R8_SPEC/R8_REVISED_SPEC.md (sha 17e1a9cddcad…, §6a) defines V-CAD-1..6; V-CAD-5 = 'no UNHANDLED class on a profile-relevant layer of the region'. No check id needs inventing, so the brief's LEGACY_UNDEFINED_CHECK_ID fallback is not used; the compatibility record is LEGACY_CHECK_ID_RESOLVED.
entries.new_decision: Expectation retained unchanged. V-CAD-5 is bound to CAD_PROFILE requirement H_FINDINGS through cad_profile.region_class_findings: census rows for unrealised classes (UNHANDLED / SKIPPED / PROXY / CUSTOM_CLASS / UNSUPPORTED) are re-scoped to the region by layer; a profile-relevant layer (the layers of the region's measured observations, plus adapter-designated role layers) gives a BLOCKING GEOMETRY_COMPLETENESS finding in the region's scope; any other layer gives REVIEW only (the spec's WARN). V-CAD ids are a reporting view (cad_profile.V_CAD_CHECKS / v_cad_view) over requirements A-I.
